title: feat(app-shell): the suggested-bindings panel shows each suggestion's state and revokes an acceptance (part of objectui#7611)
body:
Part of #7611
Clause-②: yes (widening)

**Draft by dispatch** (objectui AGENTS.md §9 ②). This is C9 part 2: the `SuggestedBindingsPanel` follow-up recorded in 6110524912 and claimed by the amendment 6110601135, after objectstack#22854 (stage U2, `d112087b8980`). The epic PM of objectstack#15194 moves this PR. The rest of #7611 stays open; part 1 landed as `0df67f237c5a`.

## What objectui now shows

On a framework at objectstack `main` `d112087b8980` or later, a `manage_metadata` holder's accept takes effect for the whole deployment, and a dismiss on an accepted row revokes it (objectstack#22801 → A). The panel on the marketplace package page and in the Studio Access pillar used to list `pending` rows only and dropped `bindingCreated`. It now lists every suggestion of the package (`GET /api/v1/security/suggested-bindings?packageId=…`, no status filter) and draws each in the state the server records:

| Row on the wire | The panel shows | Actions |
|---|---|---|
| `status: pending`, anchor `everyone` | the existing prompt | Accept, Dismiss |
| `status: pending`, anchor `guest` | the prompt, and "Cannot be granted here: the Guest position takes no sets from accepted suggestions." | Dismiss only |
| `status: confirmed`, `deployment_decision: true` | "SET was accepted for all signed-in users (the Everyone position)." | Revoke |
| the same row, after this session's accept answered `200` with `bindingCreated: false` | "SET was accepted but is not in force yet: the Everyone position did not change on this request. The server log says why." | Revoke |
| `status: dismissed` | "SET is not granted: the suggestion was dismissed or revoked." | none |
| `status: confirmed`, `deployment_decision: false` (the baseline names the set) | not drawn | none |

- **Revoke** is the existing dismiss call (`POST …/:id/dismiss`) on an accepted row. The success toast says the acceptance was revoked.
- **Accept** shows the existing success toast only when `bindingCreated` is `true`. On `false` it shows the not-in-force line as a warning toast, and the row keeps Revoke, because the acceptance is recorded. `confirmSuggestedBinding` now returns `{ suggestion, bindingCreated }` instead of dropping the flag.
- **Refusals.** A `403` or `409` on Accept, Dismiss or Revoke shows the server's own `error.message`, never a silent no-op. The panel then reads the list again, so the row shows what the server holds.
- **Kept:** a `403` on the list (a caller without `manage_metadata`) still renders nothing. The list's `.catch` in the panel's mount effect still swallows the refusal.
- The accepted line claims the decision, not that the set is in force. The list does not say whether `everyone` carries an accepted set, so "not yet in force" lasts until the panel re-reads. See the acceptance notes.
- **Styling.** The panel keeps its amber look while a row awaits a decision. With only decided rows it uses the muted look. Each state has its own Lucide shield icon.

### Why a `guest` row shows the reason instead of rendering nothing

The server refuses a `guest` accept with `409`, and still accepts a dismiss of a pending `guest` row. The panel therefore draws no Accept, says why, and keeps Dismiss. This follows the convention part 1 of this card set (`0df67f237c5a`): a caller the server would refuse gets no affordance, and the page says why. It also follows objectui#12109's rule that an affordance the server refuses is not drawn. Rendering nothing would leave a pending row that no surface can show or dismiss. No producer emits a `guest` suggestion today, so this branch is dormant until one does.

### Why a baseline row is not drawn

Its dismiss answers `409` ("this surface does not decide the baseline"), and its confirm answers `409` too. No action on it can succeed, and nothing is pending. Before this change the panel did not draw it either.

## Measured against objectstack `main`

The measurement booted a showcase from a detached objectstack worktree at `55382dc02a` (its `origin/main`, which contains `d112087b8980`). It ran through a throwaway, untracked dogfood-style file, deleted after the run, so `git status` in that worktree is clean. The driver was `sqlite-wasm`. Readings, in order:

- With a vanilla `SecurityPlugin` (so `showcase_member_default` is a package suggestion), the list row is `pending`, with `deployment_decision: false`, `resolved_by: null` and `anchor: "everyone"`.
- The accept answers `200`, `{ data: { suggestion, bindingCreated: true } }`. The suggestion is `confirmed` with `deployment_decision: true` and `resolved_by` set.
- **The list after the accept returns the same row: `status: "confirmed"`, `deployment_decision: true` (a JSON boolean) and `resolved_by` set.** It has no field that says whether the set is in force.
- A second accept answers `409 SUGGESTION_STATE`: "… is already confirmed — only pending suggestions can be accepted."
- The dismiss on the accepted row answers `200`, and the suggestion is `dismissed` with `deployment_decision: true`. The list then shows the same. **A revoked row and a dismissed pending row are identical on the wire.**
- A second dismiss answers `409`: "… is already dismissed — only a pending or accepted suggestion can be dismissed." An accept on that row answers `409` ("… only pending suggestions can be accepted").
- A signed-up member's list answers `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`: "[Security] Access denied: listing audience-binding suggestions requires the `manage_metadata` capability. …"
- On the stock showcase, the same set is a baseline row: `confirmed`, `deployment_decision: false`, `resolved_by: null`. Its dismiss answers `409`: "… is observed, not accepted: the deployment's baseline gives the set to everyone, and this surface does not decide the baseline."

`bindingCreated: false` on a `200` could not be produced through the public door on that boot: the confirm and the derivation ask the same gates. It is NOT MEASURED live here. objectstack pins it in its unit suite, and #22854's ablation showed the flag turning `false`. The panel's handling is pinned below against the documented envelope.

## Tests

The new `packages/app-shell/src/components/SuggestedBindingsPanel.test.tsx` has 15 cases. It renders the real panel and the real `suggestedBindingsApi` client over a stubbed `fetch` that answers the server's envelopes, with row shapes and messages taken from the measurement above. There was no test of this component before. The file follows app-shell's convention for a component with a stubbed transport: `vi.stubGlobal('fetch', …)`, `sonner` mocked, and `@object-ui/components` imported at module scope.

- One test per state: pending, accepted, dismissed or revoked, baseline not drawn (with a control that a baseline-only panel renders nothing), and `guest` (no Accept, the reason shown, Dismiss kept). One test pins that a `403` on the list renders nothing, and one that the list asks for every status.
- One test per action: Accept with `bindingCreated: true`; Accept with `bindingCreated: false` (not in force, a warning and no success toast); Dismiss; Revoke (the dismiss route, never confirm); Revoke refused `409` (the message is shown, the list is re-read, and the row takes the server's state); Accept refused `403`; and Revoke refused `403` followed by a list `403` (the message is shown, then the panel renders nothing).

**Ablation** (one-time, not kept). Each mutation went through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which checks that the anchor hit and that the restore holds. Each restore read blob == HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty.

- `bindingCreated: data?.bindingCreated === true` → `bindingCreated: true`: exactly the not-in-force test went red (1 failed, 14 passed).
- `return s.anchor === 'guest' ? 'guest' : 'pending';` → `return 'pending';`: exactly the `guest` test went red (1 failed, 14 passed).
- `s.status === 'confirmed' && s.deployment_decision === true` → `s.status === 'confirmed'`: exactly the two baseline tests went red (2 failed, 13 passed).

**At head `8d3b3a0eb`** (all runs under the shared verify lock):

- `pnpm exec vitest run` over the new file, `packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/` (its 29 test files mock the panel), the three Studio Access-pillar suites, `studio-locale.i18n`, `select-placeholder-literal-11252`, all of `packages/i18n/`, and the three i18n script tests: **120 files passed, 1812 tests passed, 13 skipped**. The skips are pre-existing and none is in the new file.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check`, which is `tsc --noEmit` plus `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`: both `Done`. `--listFiles` on app-shell's test project lists the new test file once.
- `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts` went red on the first run. It pins the de census, and the five new de values add seven matched `„…“` spans. The census is moved 77 → 84 with `rdq` 0, and a history line is added like those before it.

**Narrowed, and declared.** The whole of `packages/app-shell/` (1,271 test files) was started at `--maxWorkers=2`. After 19 minutes it had not finished, and a sibling's build was queued behind it. I stopped it before it printed a result, so that run is NOT MEASURED. CI's `pnpm test` runs the whole package. The diff changes no export and no shared module outside the panel, its client, the two mounts' string objects and the locale tables.

## Gates

At `8d3b3a0eb`, each exit 0: `check-i18n-call-site-keys`, `check-i18n-en-drift`, `check-i18n-designer-table-parity`, `check-control-bytes`, `check-new-cross-file-line-citations` (0 new), `check-changeset-presence` (17 source files of 2 released packages, 1 changeset), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-vi-mock-override-shape`, `check-test-path-roots`. `check-i18n-dead-keys` is report-only and names none of the new keys. A control-byte self-scan over the diff found nothing.

**ESLint** (`--no-inline-config`, `--format json`) over the 17 touched TS files reports 1 error and 29 warnings. The base file under the same flags reads the same: `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 1 error and 14 warnings, `MarketplacePackagePage.tsx` 0 and 11, `suggestedBindingsApi.ts` 0 and 4. The error is the pre-existing `react-hooks/static-components` finding in that file, far from this diff. The panel goes from 1 warning to 0. The population is each package's own `eslint .` under the root `eslint.config.js`. That config enables no type-aware linting, so this diff cannot change a verdict on an untouched file. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

**NOT MEASURED locally**: `check-eager-closure-budget` and `check-eager-locale-catalogues`, which need a full console build and are CI's (`performance-budget.yml`). The `en` pack grows by seven short values. A browser drive of the panel is also not measured: a stock showcase has no pending suggestion for the panel to draw, and a vanilla-plugin boot needs an objectstack configuration change this card does not make. The wire was measured instead, above.

## Changeset

`.changeset/7611-suggested-binding-states.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` minor (a new user-visible action) and `@object-ui/i18n` minor. **Clause-②: yes (widening)**: seven locale keys are added to the published packs (`marketplace.suggestedBindings.guestUnsupported`, `acceptedState`, `notInForceState`, `dismissedState`, `revoke`, `revoking`, `revokedToast`), which widens `TranslationKeys`. No export, prop or accept set moves. The panel and its client are not exported from `@object-ui/app-shell`. The Studio Access pillar's own table gains the matching seven `engine.studio.access.suggest…` keys in English and Chinese.

No doc names this panel: a grep of `content/` and every `*.md` outside changesets and changelogs finds nothing, so no doc is updated.

## Acceptance notes (out of scope; carrier: none named)

- **The list cannot say whether an accepted set is in force.** An accepted row reads the same whether `everyone` carries the set or the derivation withholds it. A withhold happens when a later publish adds a forbidden bit, or the catalog stops serving the set. So the panel's accepted line claims the decision only, and "not yet in force" survives only until the panel re-reads. Closing that would take a server field on the list row. That is an objectstack contract question, not an objectui fix.
- **A revoke is final on this surface.** A revoked row is `dismissed` with a deployment decision. The reconcile never re-opens such a row, and confirm takes `pending` only. Re-accepting a revoked set therefore has no route here, which the measurement above shows (`409` on confirm after a revoke). Dismissing a pending row was already final before #22854.
- A revoked row and a declined row are the same on the wire, so after a re-read the panel says "dismissed or revoked" for both.

## Size

Against base `158c75d` (`git diff --shortstat 158c75d 8d3b3a0eb`): 18 files, 667 additions and 79 deletions, so 746 changed lines. The new test file is 288 of them, and the ten locale packs are 70.
